svg.title: Moonbase Mac mini AI Command Deck architecture
svg.desc: Authenticated browser requests pass through Cloudflare Access and the Moonbase Airlock session guard to reach the Mac mini Node service. The Mac Mirror controller captures GitHub Copilot, Claude Desktop, and the full Mac mini display; the Photo Frame service streams slides from local or uploaded folders; and the Live Session Watcher tails local JSONL logs to drive downstairs mini dinosaur workers.
